Class ListView.Builder<T,K>

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement.Builder<ListView<T>, ListView.Builder<T,K>>
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ListView.Builder<T,K>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
K - the key type
Enclosing class:
ListView<T>
public static final class ListView.Builder<T,K> extends AbstractPanelElement.Builder<ListView<T>, ListView.Builder<T,K>>
Builds a ListView. items, key and row are required; call key before selection and the editing options, since it fixes the key's type.

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> add(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label, Supplier<? extends @Nullable K> action)

    • removeDisabledWhen

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> removeDisabledWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Grays the remove while condition holds, read every frame: the toolbar's "- Remove item" and, with controlsInRows(), every row's cross (a config list at its minimum length). A click on a grayed remove does nothing. Needs remove.

    • confirmRemove

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> confirmRemove(Function<? super T, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> body)

    • move

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> move(BiConsumer<? super K, Integer> move)
      Up and down buttons in the toolbar, after remove, that move the selected row one place (with controlsInRows(), in each row): a click hands the row's key and the place it should go in items() to move. Alt+Up and Alt+Down do the same. Can't be on a list with sort(Component, Comparator).

    • pinned

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> pinned(Predicate<? super T> pinned)
      Rows that stay put: they can't be removed or moved, and no other row moves past them. Read every frame.

    • controlsInRows

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> controlsInRows()
      Up, down and a remove cross in each row instead of in the toolbar, for a small list where each row is its own thing to edit (a config list of text fields). They sit on the row's first line at its trailing edge, after a divider line: inside a card, or beside a bare row. Add stays in the toolbar. Needs remove or move.

    • disabledReason

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> disabledReason(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component reason)

    • search

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> search(Function<? super T, String> text)
      A search field in the toolbar: a row shows while its item's text holds the query, case-insensitive. The query is the list's own view state.

    • sort

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> sort(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component label, Comparator<? super T> order)
      A way to sort the rows, labeled label in the sort picker; call once per way. The first is the default. With two or more, the toolbar has a picker and a direction toggle. Can't be on a list with move: a sorted list has no order of its own to move a row in.

    • title

      public ListView.Builder<T,K> title(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component title)
      The list's heading, on the toolbar's line at its left edge, before the search field and the buttons: one line for both. Drawn in the look's heading style, centered on the buttons, cut with "..." when it would reach them. A list with a title and nothing else for a toolbar still has the title's line.

    • title
